Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: O01
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/operations engineer
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: A clean institutional staging host can run a pinned Sanctity release without using sbt as the service manager.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Supply a versioned artifact/deployment manifest, validated configuration, TLS/origin and secret setup, process supervision and graceful shutdown.
2. Separate migration privileges/command from runtime database access; retain drift checks and provide upgrade failure/restore procedures and compatibility checks for old releases.
3. Rehearse clean installation and an upgrade from the existing schema with pinned sources/dependencies and retained results; do not claim hosted CI or deployment execution without receipts.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.
